answer: The cheapest real defence: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because ocean only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, ferrous is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any sable approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
